name: Story poll frame
oneLiner: a metal-and-glass phone swings in on a vertical story (the brand screen over its own blurred copy, segmented progress, avatar and time); a poll sticker drops onto the glass and lands with a spring, a tap on the first option splits the votes as the bars fill and the percents count, then the progress segment completes and the story cube-turns to the next one
say: when the speaker says they asked their audience ('I put up a poll on my story', 'I asked my followers and 78% said yes'): the sticker lands on the question, the votes split as they say the number, the story turns on 'so I made it'. Set question, optionA, optionB and split to the real poll
